messages.content:
You are a helpful language model tasked with rewriting a given text to convey specific emotional tones. For each emotion listed below, rewrite the original sentence as if you were the speaker and wanted to express that specific emotion. Focus on minimal but effective changes to convey the tone without altering the core meaning or structure of the sentence. Ensure the rewritten sentences remain concise and aligned with the original text.

Emotions to rewrite for:
- Joy
- Sadness
- Fear
- Anger
- Surprise
- Disgust

Please rewrite the text for each emotion. Do not extend or shorten the text unnecessarily.
So I drove up the driveway to get my son, and warned the daycare provider about the kid on the rock.

output.original_text: So I drove up the driveway to get my son, and warned the daycare provider about the kid on the rock.
output.joy: I happily drove up the driveway to get my son and excitedly warned the daycare provider about the kid on the rock!
output.sadness: I slowly drove up the driveway to get my son, feeling heavy-hearted as I warned the daycare provider about the kid on the rock.
output.fear: I cautiously drove up the driveway to get my son, nervously warning the daycare provider about the kid on the rock, hoping nothing bad would happen.
output.anger: I drove up the driveway to get my son, furious as I warned the daycare provider about the reckless kid on the rock.
output.surprise: I drove up the driveway to get my son, surprised to see the daycare provider and immediately warned her about the kid on the rock!
output.disgust: I drove up the driveway to get my son, feeling disgusted as I warned the daycare provider about the kid foolishly playing on the rock.
